modelHints.zeroneurone: A single confidence level from 0 to 100%, in steps of 10.
modelHints.europol: Source reliability (A, B, C, X) and information accuracy (1 to 4), as set by Article 29 of Regulation (EU) 2016/794.
modelHints.admiralty: Source reliability (A to F) and information credibility (1 to 6), following the Admiralty code used by NATO.

sourcesHelp.A: No doubt as to the authenticity, trustworthiness and competence of the source, or the source has proved to be reliable in all instances.
sourcesHelp.B: The source has in most instances proved to be reliable.
sourcesHelp.C: The source has in most instances proved to be unreliable.
sourcesHelp.X: The reliability of the source cannot be assessed.

infosHelp.1: Information whose accuracy is not in doubt.
infosHelp.2: Information known personally to the source but not known personally to the official passing it on.
infosHelp.3: Information not known personally to the source but corroborated by other information already recorded.
infosHelp.4: Information not known personally to the source and which cannot be corroborated.

sourcesHelp.A: No doubt of authenticity, trustworthiness or competency; has a history of complete reliability.
sourcesHelp.B: Minor doubt about authenticity, trustworthiness or competency; has provided valid information most of the time.
sourcesHelp.C: Doubt of authenticity, trustworthiness or competency, but has provided valid information in the past.
sourcesHelp.D: Significant doubt about authenticity, trustworthiness or competency, but has provided valid information in the past.
sourcesHelp.E: Lacking in authenticity, trustworthiness and competency; history of invalid information.
sourcesHelp.F: No basis exists for evaluating the reliability of the source.

infosHelp.1: Confirmed by other independent sources; logical in itself; consistent with other information on the subject.
infosHelp.2: Not confirmed; logical in itself; consistent with other information on the subject.
infosHelp.3: Not confirmed; reasonably logical in itself; agrees with some other information on the subject.
infosHelp.4: Not confirmed; possible but not logical; no other information on the subject.
infosHelp.5: Not confirmed; not logical in itself; contradicted by other information on the subject.
infosHelp.6: No basis exists for evaluating the validity of the information.
